First seen in our archive in 1000 (cma-133068); the third-earliest painting is 1000, and the latest 2000 (2059 dated paintings, at least 2% of the canvas, as photographed). The archive's early centuries are thin, so this is a floor, not a first. That is 650 years before the name's earliest record in our sources (1650): the match is a look-alike hue in an aged photograph, not proof of the pigment or dye.
